facts: Unit.Defaults2f144c clears the word at+3bb, including mHasActivated+3bc.
Unit.UpdateSelf2f14af..1507 skips activation when mHasActivated is true or nonempty UnitData.ActivateGraphic equals the actual primary animation name.
Otherwise2f150d..1590 executes original OnActivationFinished scripts in registration order with Script.isSource and actual Unit Lua table.
Only after those callbacks return does2f1597 set mHasActivated=true, before the alive check and movement/arsenal/status phases.
Original RoomManager.lua OnActivationFinished sets ActivationFinished and invokes SetupAI; starting AI directly at SpawnUnit would bypass this lifecycle.
implementation: Real registered Unit lifetimes store hasActivated=false; manager tick snapshots registration order before dispatch.
The activation phase compares the actual primary registry name, dispatches the original callback with Thing matching, then records activation on the surviving matching lifetime.
adaptations: The existing portable world update groups unit phases rather than interleaving each complete native Unit.UpdateSelf. Activation is restored before the grouped unit work; full manager phase equivalence is not claimed.
